visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses lies in bed, speaking to the camera while a gray and white cat rests on his chest. A young child is seen resting behind him on the pillows. The room has soft, warm indoor lighting with a simple wooden headboard visible. (2) The scene shifts to a kitchen where the man is grating a piece of ginger onto a metal grater while the young girl, wearing a pink patterned mask, watches closely. The kitchen is modern with white cabinetry and a wooden cutting board. (3) The man places thinly sliced meat into a glass bowl and adds dark soy sauce, stirring the mixture with a spoon. The lighting is bright and even studio-style indoor light. (4) Close-up shots of the man cutting cabbage into thin strips on a wooden board. The girl assists by placing the shredded cabbage onto a large white plate. (5) On a black stovetop, the man uses tongs to stir-fry onions and the marinated meat in a stainless steel pan. Steam rises from the pan as the ingredients sizzle. (6) The man presents a finished plate of ginger pork served with a large mound of shredded cabbage. He and the child are sitting at a wooden dining table, and the man begins eating the meal with chopsticks. (7) A transition shows the man and child sitting at a table together drawing on white paper with orange markers. The background shows a large silver refrigerator. (8) Back in the kitchen, the man boils water in a large metal pot on the stove. He adds a large white tea bag to the boiling water and later pours the brown liquid into a large clear plastic bottle using a yellow funnel. (9) A woman with her hair in a bun appears in the kitchen, handing snacks in paper bags to the young girl and a baby sitting in a high chair. They are all eating small, round, yellow fried snacks. (10) The man prepares another meal using a specialized white 'THANKO' brand rice cooker bowl. He chops chicken on a board, sautés onions and chicken in a pan, and adds a beaten egg mixture. (11) He pours a multi-grain rice mix and water into the bottom of the cooker and places the chicken mixture in a separate tray on top. He presses a button to start the cooking process. (12) The man opens the lid to reveal the cooked rice and chicken bowl. He eats the meal with a spoon, expressing satisfaction while sitting in a dining area with a modern refrigerator in the background. (13) Late at night, a woman is seen eating instant noodles and meat from a bowl while the man watches and talks to her. The scene ends with a 2D animation of a man lying down and a woman standing next to him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice narrating in an energetic, conversational tone over light, acoustic guitar-driven background music. There is the faint sound of soft bedding moving as he speaks. (2) A sharp, rhythmic scraping sound occurs as a ginger root is grated against metal, accompanied by the high-pitched, playful voice of a child responding to the man. (3) A sequence of metallic clinks and soft thuds follows as objects are moved in the kitchen. (4) Loud, crisp sizzling sounds emerge as meat and onions hit a hot pan, with the bubbling sound of liquid being poured in shortly after. (5) Percussive chewing and swallowing sounds are heard as the man eats, punctuated by a child excitedly saying 'hao chi' (delicious). (6) A distinct scribbling sound of markers on paper provides a short transition. (7) The sound of rushing water and a heavy pot lid clanking on metal signifies the start of a new kitchen task. (8) Crinkling paper and plastic bag rustling are heard as the family interacts, followed by loud crunching sounds as snacks are eaten. (9) A hollow, glugging sound occurs as liquid is poured into a large plastic bottle. (10) The thudding sound of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board indicates meat preparation. (11) A mechanical beep and a metallic click sound when the rice cooker is operated, followed by the soft hiss of steam escaping when the lid is opened later. (12) Loud slurping sounds of noodles being eaten by a woman are heard, accompanied by playful banter and laughter between the adults.
